intents.name: loan_products
intents.answer:
💼 *L&T Finance — Comprehensive Loan Offerings*

1. 🏍️ *Two-Wheeler Loans:* Up to ₹20 Lakhs, up to 100% on-road funding, instant digital approval.
2. 💰 *Personal Loans:* Up to ₹15L–₹30L, 100% paperless digital journey, flexible tenure.
3. 🏡 *Home Loans & LAP:* Competitive interest rates, up to 30 years tenure, balance transfer & top-up.
4. 🪙 *Gold Loans:* Starting from ₹5,000, rates from 11.75%* p.a., 24x7 vault security.
5. 🏢 *Business / SME Loans:* Collateral-free working capital & machinery loans up to ₹50 Lakhs.
6. 🚜 *Farm Equipment / Tractor Loans:* New & used tractor finance with seasonal crop repayment.
7. 🌾 *Rural Business Finance (Vikaas Loans):* Group micro-loans empowering women entrepreneurs.

_Tap 'Apply Now' or 'Request Callback' to get started!_

intents.name: self_service
intents.answer:
📲 *L&T Finance — Instant Digital Services*

You can manage your loan 24x7 via WhatsApp or the *PLANET by L&T Finance* app:

📄 *Download Documents:*
• Statement of Account (SOA)
• Repayment Schedule
• Interest Certificate (Provisional & Final)
• Foreclosure Statement / Settlement Letter
• No Objection Certificate (NOC / No Dues Certificate)

💳 *Payments & Account:*
• Pay EMI online via UPI / NetBanking / Debit Card
• Check Outstanding Balance & Next Due Date
• Update Bank Mandate (NACH/e-Mandate)

_Download the PLANET app or type your Loan Account Number (LAN) to fetch details._

intents.name: apply_loan
intents.answer:
📝 *Apply for an L&T Finance Loan*

Applying is 100% digital, fast, and paperless:
1. Select your loan category (Personal, Two-Wheeler, Home, Gold, SME, Tractor).
2. Keep your PAN Card, Aadhaar, and recent bank statements ready.
3. Get instant in-principle eligibility & approval.
4. Quick disbursal directly into your verified bank account.

_Tap 'Request Callback' to speak with an authorized loan advisor!_

intents.name: faqs
intents.answer:
❓ *Frequently Asked Questions*

• *How do I pay my missed EMI?* Pay instantly online via ltfs.com/quickpay, PLANET App, or UPI.
• *How long does NOC take after loan closure?* 7 to 14 working days after realization of full dues.
• *Customer Care Helpline:* Call 1800-268-0000 (Mon–Sun, 9 AM – 6 PM).
• *WhatsApp Banking:* +91 7378333451
• *Grievance Escalation:* Write to customercare@ltfs.com or GRO at gro@ltfs.com.
